sentences.text: Un hombre tenía dos hijos.
sentences.english: A man had two sons.

sentences.text: Un día el hijo menor le dijo a su padre: —Quiero que me des la parte del dinero que me toca.
sentences.english: One day the younger son said to his father, "I want you to give me the part of the money that is mine."

sentences.text: El padre se lo dio, aunque le dolía mucho.
sentences.english: The father gave it to him, even though it hurt him very much.

sentences.text: El hijo menor juntó todo lo que tenía y se fue a un país lejano.
sentences.english: The younger son gathered everything he had and went to a faraway country.

sentences.text: Allí gastó el dinero en fiestas y en cosas que no necesitaba.
sentences.english: There he spent the money on parties and on things he did not need.

sentences.text: Cuando ya no le quedaba nada, llegó un hambre fuerte a aquella tierra.
sentences.english: When he had nothing left, a severe hunger came to that land.

sentences.text: El joven, que nunca había pasado necesidad, empezó a sufrir.
sentences.english: The young man, who had never been in need, began to suffer.

sentences.text: Buscó trabajo, y un hombre lo mandó a cuidar cerdos.
sentences.english: He looked for work, and a man sent him to look after pigs.

sentences.text: Tenía tanta hambre que habría querido comer lo mismo que los cerdos, pero nadie le daba nada.
sentences.english: He was so hungry that he would have liked to eat the same food as the pigs, but nobody gave him anything.

sentences.text: Entonces pensó: —En la casa de mi padre, hasta los trabajadores tienen pan de sobra, y yo me muero de hambre aquí.
sentences.english: Then he thought, "In my father's house even the workers have plenty of bread, and I am dying of hunger here."

sentences.text: Voy a volver con mi padre y le voy a decir: «He pecado contra Dios y contra ti, y ya no merezco que me llames hijo; trátame como a uno de tus trabajadores.»
sentences.english: I am going to go back to my father and say to him, 'I have sinned against God and against you, and I no longer deserve to be called your son; treat me like one of your workers.'"

sentences.text: Se levantó y volvió a su casa.
sentences.english: He got up and went back to his home.

sentences.text: Cuando todavía estaba lejos, su padre lo vio y sintió compasión.
sentences.english: While he was still far away, his father saw him and felt compassion.

sentences.text: El padre corrió hacia él, lo abrazó y lo besó.
sentences.english: The father ran toward him, hugged him and kissed him.

sentences.text: El hijo empezó a decir lo que había preparado, pero su padre no lo dejó terminar.
sentences.english: The son began to say what he had prepared, but his father did not let him finish.

sentences.text: Llamó a sus criados y les dijo: —Traigan la mejor ropa y vístanlo, y pónganle también un anillo y zapatos.
sentences.english: He called his servants and said to them, "Bring the best clothes and dress him, and put a ring and shoes on him too."

sentences.text: Hagamos una fiesta, porque mi hijo estaba perdido y ya lo hemos encontrado: era como si hubiera muerto y ha vuelto a vivir.
sentences.english: Let us have a party, because my son was lost and now we have found him: it was as if he had died, and he has come back to life."

sentences.text: Mientras tanto, el hijo mayor volvía del campo.
sentences.english: Meanwhile, the older son was coming back from the field.

sentences.text: Al acercarse a la casa, oyó música y supo que había una fiesta.
sentences.english: As he came near the house, he heard music and learned that there was a party.

sentences.text: Preguntó qué pasaba, y un criado le dijo que su hermano había vuelto.
sentences.english: He asked what was going on, and a servant told him that his brother had come back.

sentences.text: El hijo mayor se enojó mucho y no quiso entrar.
sentences.english: The older son became very angry and did not want to go in.

sentences.text: El padre salió a buscarlo y le pidió que entrara.
sentences.english: The father went out to find him and asked him to come in.

sentences.text: —Yo te he servido durante muchos años —respondió el hijo mayor—, y nunca me diste ni un cabrito para celebrar con mis amigos.
sentences.english: "I have served you for many years," the older son answered, "and you never gave me even a young goat to celebrate with my friends."

sentences.text: Pero cuando vuelve este hijo tuyo, que gastó tu dinero, haces una fiesta para él.
sentences.english: But when this son of yours comes back, the one who spent your money, you throw a party for him."

sentences.text: —Hijo mío —dijo el padre—, tú siempre estás conmigo y todo lo que tengo es tuyo.
sentences.english: "My son," said the father, "you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.

sentences.text: Pero teníamos que alegrarnos, porque tu hermano estaba perdido y ha sido encontrado.
sentences.english: But we had to be glad, because your brother was lost and has been found."

sentences.text: La historia no dice si el hijo mayor entró a la fiesta.
sentences.english: The story does not say whether the older son went into the party.
